📰 AI & Junior Devs: Threat or Transformation?

A Software Engineering Institute empirical study reveals AI automates routine coding tasks but amplifies the need for human oversight, reshaping — not eliminating — junior developer roles. Companies are restructuring entry-level hiring around AI supervision and system-level thinking.

📅 11 Oct 2026 | Source: Software Engineering Institute Empirical Study
